newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian govt strategy unaffected by A$.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian govt strategy unaffected by A$.

text.p: Australian Finance Minister John Fahey said on Monday the government's economic strategy was unaffected by the level of the currency.

"The government takes the view that the market should set that particular rate (for the Australian dollar)," Fahey told Reuters Financial Television in an interview from the World Economic Forum, Davos, Switzerland.
"And it does not particularly impact on what we have as an economic and fiscal strategy," he said.
The Australian dollar has tended lower in the past two months and was trading at US$0.7620 at 0930 GMT.
However, its rise last year -- to a peak of US$0.8215 in November -- helped push Australian inflation down to a 1.5 percent annual rate in the December quarter.
